claim: A 60 Hz frame has 264 lines on the N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone, core 3.03.00, 128K timing, $11 = 0), as the book says, not the 262 / 261 docs/TECHNIQUES.md gave. Where the mode is unknown, wait only for lines below 261.
limit: Measured at one setting of one board ($11 = 0, 128K timing, HDMI cable; nxsuite F03, F06); 48K timing, the other VGA timings and HDMI modes not measured.

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 10
evidence.text: 60 Hz (NextREG 0x05 bit 2, not Pentagon): 264 lines instead of 311 / 312, display area from line 40, no border above or below the wide area; 58.15 Hz at 128K timing, 59.19 Hz at 48K.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite F03): after $05 bit 2 was set the frames were 264 lines (311 at 50 Hz), 228.02 T a line at both rates.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite F06): at 60 Hz the ULA interrupt came at line 224 of 264, 40 lines before the display (line 0); at 50 Hz at line 248 of 311.
